LightningComponentBundle.description: Visit Reports logged against a provider, one row per visit report, with purpose breakdown and filters.

property.name: monthsBack
property.label: Default date window (months)
property.description: Rolling window applied on load. 0 means all time, which is the default because most Florida visit history predates the 2025 Visit Report cutover.

property.name: rowLimit
property.label: Row limit
property.description: Maximum visits to load. Capped at 2000 by the controller.

property.name: showNotes
property.label: Show notes column
property.description: Uncheck to hide visit notes from the table.
